_provenance.purpose: Canada and United States seed priors for PickMe's learning merchant-MCC graph.
_provenance.rule: Seed MCCs are editorial hypotheses, never observed network MCCs. Runtime observations must override priors as evidence accumulates.
_provenance.merchantScope: 500 Canadian merchants plus an additive, cited 50-merchant United States tranche. Existing Canadian IDs are immutable; cross-market brands receive distinct IDs only when country-scoped evidence can differ.

communitySource.name: MCC-Codes.com Canada
communitySource.use: Location-level low-confidence evidence only; directory disclaims accuracy and changes without notice.
